items.title: Fed minutes show growing unease about the outlook for inflation

items.title: Grand Theft Callout: ‘GTA 6’ fans are missing work to play — and some companies are making the game’s release a holiday
items.content: After waiting 13 years for this videogame, almost one-fifth of workers are said to be taking Thursday off to play ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ when it drops

items.title: Washington is scrambling to get to the bottom of the growing number of tech outages across America
items.content: The Trump administration and Congress have been rushing to address the series of technology failures that have hit the U.S. over the past week, with Vice President J.D. Vance withdrawing from an event Wednesday in order to take part in meetings on the issue.
